# Reactive ariaCurrent_ on buttons and batched HeaderToolbar activeId

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for Engine v14 delivery (follow-up to `#21532` / `#21530`, excluding curated contributor labels per `ticket-create` §4).

## Context

PR `#21532` (resolving `#21530`) added `Neo.app.header.Toolbar#activeId_` so Portal header links expose `aria-current="page"`. While functional for basic route clicks, `Toolbar#setAriaCurrent` (`src/app/header/Toolbar.mjs:84-98`) mutates child button VDOM directly (`button.getVdomRoot()['aria-current'] = 'page'` / `delete`) and calls `button.update()` twice in a row (`afterSetActiveId`, lines `68-69`).

## The Problem

External raw-VDOM surgery on child components violates Neo.mjs's reactive config and two-tier encapsulation model (`src/core/Base.mjs:75-89`, `src/Neo.mjs:355-442`, `learn/guides/fundamentals/DeclarativeComponentTreesVsImperativeVdom.md`):

1. **Bypasses `Neo.core.Config` & `EffectManager`:** External writes to `vdomRoot['aria-current']` create no `Config` controller, so `state.Provider` bindings (`bind: {ariaCurrent: ...}`), `observeConfig()`, and `Effect` subscribers cannot drive or observe the state.
2. **Clobbered on `Effect` / Functional button re-renders:** `Neo.button.Effect#getVdomConfig` (`src/button/Effect.mjs:178-185, 228-250`) and `Neo.functional.button.Base#createVdom` (`src/functional/button/Base.mjs:159-181`) rebuild `_vdom` from reactive configs on any dependency change (e.g. `badgeText`), wiping externally injected `vdomRoot['aria-current']`.
3. **Invisible to inspection & cloning:** `Neo.button.Base#toJSON` (`src/button/Base.mjs:713-731`) and `Neo.cloneNeoInstance` (`src/Neo.mjs:267-274`) drop `ariaCurrent`.
4. **Drops construction-time `activeId`:** `Neo.create` runs `construct` (`initConfig` -> `afterSetActiveId(value, undefined)`) before `Container#onConstructed` calls `createItems()` (`src/container/Base.mjs:880-881`) and before `Toolbar#onConstructed` adds `header-canvas` (`src/app/header/Toolbar.mjs:103-111`). Passing `activeId` at construction finds neither the child button nor `header-canvas`.
5. **Two unbatched VDOM worker round-trips:** In `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1055-1082` and `1483-1545`, `mergeIntoParentUpdate(toolbar.id)` returns `false` when `Toolbar` itself is idle (`!toolbar.needsVdomUpdate && !VDomUpdate.isAwaitingCollection(toolbar.id)`). Calling `oldButton.update()` followed by `newButton.update()` across two sibling instances dispatches **two separate `VdomHelper.updateBatch` flights** instead of one atomic batch.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: "I configure a component tree abstraction that sits above the VDom layer. Components define their internal DOM via `vdom`." (`learn/guides/fundamentals/DeclarativeComponentTreesVsImperativeVdom.md:78`) and `Neo.core.Base` reactive config lifecycle (`src/core/Base.mjs:75-89`).

- **Why `Neo.button.Base` (+ `Effect` + `functional.button.Base`) rather than `Neo.component.Base`:** `Neo.core.Base#mergeConfig` (`src/core/Base.mjs:773`) and `processConfigs` (`src/core/Base.mjs:943-962`) eagerly iterate every reactive key in `ctor.config`, allocating a `new Neo.core.Config` in `#configs[key]` and invoking setter hooks on every instance. Scoping `ariaCurrent_: null` to button primitives (alongside `pressed_: null` in `src/button/Base.mjs:136`) avoids taxing non-navigational containers, grid cells, fields, and toolbars, while covering `<button>`, route/url `<a>` links, and `Neo.button.Split` (whose `getVdomRoot()` targets the primary `<button>`).
- **WAI-ARIA 1.2 `aria-current` value space:** Valid tokens are `'page' | 'step' | 'location' | 'date' | 'time' | 'true' | Boolean | null`. Normalizing `false -> null` omits the attribute cleanly when inactive; `true -> 'true'` preserves boolean shorthand.
- **Single-flight Teleportation batching:** Initiating `me.mounted && me.update()` on `Toolbar` (`updateDepth: 1`) before setting `oldButton.ariaCurrent = null` and `newButton.ariaCurrent = 'page'` registers `toolbar.id` in `VDomUpdate.awaitingCollectionSet` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:274-278`). Both sibling buttons then satisfy `mergeIntoParentUpdate(toolbar.id) === true` and ship as disjoint Depth-1 payloads in a **single** `VdomHelper.updateBatch` call while keeping normal `Config`/`Effect` notifications and skipping clean sibling items.
- **Structural Pre-Flight:** New unit spec `test/playwright/unit/button/AriaCurrent.spec.mjs` matches sibling `test/playwright/unit/button/AriaPressed.spec.mjs` and `EffectAriaPressed.spec.mjs` (Stage 1 fast-path).

## The Fix

1. **`src/button/Base.mjs`:**
   - Add `static ariaCurrentValues = ['date', 'location', 'page', 'step', 'time', 'true', null]`.
   - Add reactive `ariaCurrent_: null` config.
   - Implement `beforeSetAriaCurrent(value, oldValue)` normalizing `false -> null` and `true -> 'true'`, then validating via `this.beforeSetEnumValue(value, oldValue, 'ariaCurrent', 'ariaCurrentValues')`.
   - Implement `afterSetAriaCurrent(value, oldValue)` guarding `if (oldValue !== undefined || value)` and calling `this.changeVdomRootKey('aria-current', value)`.
   - Include `ariaCurrent: me.ariaCurrent` in `toJSON()`.
2. **`src/button/Effect.mjs` & `src/functional/button/Base.mjs`:**
   - Add `ariaCurrent_: null` (with identical normalization/enum validation on `Effect` and `functional.button.Base`) and emit `'aria-current': me.ariaCurrent` when non-null in `getVdomConfig()` / `createVdom()` so subsequent reactive re-renders preserve `aria-current`.
3. **`src/app/header/Toolbar.mjs`:**
   - Add `canvasConfig: null` so subclasses and unit hosts can customize the `header-canvas` child without bypassing `onConstructed()`.
   - Remove imperative `setAriaCurrent(id, current)`.
   - Guard `afterSetActiveId(value, oldValue)` while `!me.isConstructed`; when constructed, initiate `me.mounted && (oldButton || newButton) && me.update()` before updating `oldButton.ariaCurrent = null` and `newButton.ariaCurrent = 'page'` so both merge into one Teleportation `updateBatch`, and forward `canvas.activeId = value`.
   - In `onConstructed()`, after `super.onConstructed()` creates child items, pass `activeId: this.activeId` into `header-canvas` (merged with `canvasConfig`) and apply initial `this.activeId` to the matching child button (`ariaCurrent = 'page'`).
4. **Unit Tests:**
   - Add `test/playwright/unit/button/AriaCurrent.spec.mjs` covering `Neo.button.Base`, `Neo.button.Split`, `Neo.button.Effect` (preserving `aria-current` across `badgeText` updates), `Neo.functional.button.Base`, shared-fixture token normalization/validation parity across all three button classes, and `toJSON()`.
   - Extend `test/playwright/unit/app/HeaderToolbarActiveId.spec.mjs` to exercise real `Toolbar#onConstructed` via `canvasConfig`, verify `button.ariaCurrent` state, construction-time `activeId` propagation to both button and `header-canvas`, and single-flight `VdomHelper.updateBatch` batching across section switches.

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `Neo.button.Base`, `Neo.button.Split`, `Neo.button.Effect`, and `Neo.functional.button.Base` expose reactive `ariaCurrent_` supporting WAI-ARIA `aria-current` tokens plus `Boolean`/`null` normalization (`false -> null`, `true -> 'true'`), surviving `Effect`/`functional` VDOM re-renders and serializing in `Neo.button.Base#toJSON()`.
- [ ] AC-2: `Neo.app.header.Toolbar` removes raw `vdomRoot['aria-current']` surgery (`setAriaCurrent`), drives `button.ariaCurrent`, propagates construction-time `activeId` to both the target button and `header-canvas` (customizable via `canvasConfig`), and coalesces mounted section switches into a single `VdomHelper.updateBatch` call.
- [ ] AC-3: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/button/ test/playwright/unit/app/HeaderToolbarActiveId.spec.mjs` passes with dedicated specs for AC-1 and AC-2.

## Out of Scope

- `Neo.toolbar.Breadcrumb` adoption of `ariaCurrent_` (tracked in `#21543`).
- Moving `ariaCurrent_` onto `Neo.component.Base` (rejected below).

## Avoided Traps

- **Placing `ariaCurrent_` on `Neo.component.Base`:** `core.Base#processConfigs` (`src/core/Base.mjs:943-962`) instantiates a `Neo.core.Config` and runs setter hooks for every reactive key on every subclass instance; taxing every Container, Grid cell, and Form field for a navigational link/button state is unnecessary overhead.
- **Assuming `2x sibling button.update()` auto-batches under an idle parent:** `VdomLifecycle#mergeIntoParentUpdate` returns `false` unless an ancestor is already updating, causing two worker flights unless the parent initiates or coordinates the cycle.
